base_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual inventory icon for a Chinese xianxia cultivation RPG. One single isolated item, centered, fills 72% of a square canvas, genuine transparent background. Hand-painted semi-realistic fantasy game item art, warm ivory highlights, antique-gold details, softly outlined clean readable silhouette at 32px. Three-quarter view, soft upper-left light, subtle contained magical light ONLY immediately around object. No border, no tile, no scene, no ground plane, no text, no numerals, no letters, no watermark.
